_source: The "Jump to" site selector rendered on every RealAuction page, read 2026-09-15. It is RealAuction's own public directory of the portals it runs. Read from two pages and merged, because the selector omits the site you are already on: Charlotte is absent from Charlotte's own copy.
_why: Two things it settles that guessing could not: which counties run a tax deed sale on RealAuction at all, and whether a county's host is the tax deed site or the mortgage foreclosure site. A county listed only as 'Foreclosure' sells no tax deeds here, and filing one as inventory would be wrong.
_shape: Labels verbatim. 'Taxdeed' and 'Treasurer Deed' are tax sales; 'Foreclosure' is a mortgage foreclosure sale and is not inventory. A bare county name runs both kinds on one host, separated by the sale date — which is why lib/ingest/adapters/realauction.ts reads the page's own Auction Type rather than trusting the host.
